description: This file manages configurations and filters related to test files for various channels in a project. It defines root directories, include and exclude patterns, and functions to determine if a given file is a test file for channels based on path conventions.

methods.name: normalizeRepoPath
methods.description: Converts backslash-separated paths to slash-separated paths for normalization.

methods.name: isChannelSurfaceTestFile
methods.description: Checks whether a given file path corresponds to a channel surface test file based on specific path prefix and exclusion criteria.
